overview_tab.description: Displays KPI Score (0%), MIS Entries count, KRAs (25), Evaluations (2) for current user. Shows My KRAs section with weight badges.

my_mis_tab.description: Shows daily MIS entry form when template assigned, 'no template' message otherwise. Includes date picker and history toggle.

my_kpis_tab.description: Displays KPI scores table with weighted score, target vs actual, source (Auto/Manual). Empty state for users without KPIs.

evaluations_tab.description: Lists evaluations with Employee, Cycle, Period, Self/Manager/HR ratings, Status. HR can create new evaluations.

admin_tab.description: HR-only. Shows Seed Data, MIS Compliance (submitted/not submitted), MIS Templates with fields, KPI Definitions grouped by employee, KRA Definitions grouped by employee.

company_tab.description: HR-only. Shows company stats (72 employees, 3 MIS assigned), Senior Executive KRAs, Department Summary table.

period_selector.description: Dropdown with Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly/Half Yearly/Annual. Changes data display across all tabs.

create_kpi_dialog.description: Employee dropdown, KPI name, target value, unit selector (%, count, INR, avg), weight, calculation type, MIS field key

create_kra_dialog.description: Employee dropdown, KRA name, description textarea, weight input

assign_mis_template_dialog.description: Employee dropdown, dynamic field builder with label, type selector (number/boolean/text/dropdown), options for dropdown type

create_evaluation_dialog.description: Employee dropdown, cycle selector, period label input, HR comments textarea

seed_data_button.description: Populates 3 MIS templates, 15 KPIs, 25 KRAs for demo employees
